answer: Pay only a whisper that reaches settlement through a quorum of separate inlet branches: the first claim from one principal needs one inlet, a second concurrent claim needs two further inlet signatures, a third needs three further, and every inlet may sign one whisper per epoch only after locking tundra, forfeited if it countersigns twice or across linked branches. n clones consume 1+2+...+n distinct inlet signatures and tundra locks each epoch; reused or rented overlap burns the lock.
